comments.text: For the twins animation, the kid with the glasses got hit by the car. If his ankle is hurting and he's on the ground, how would he be able to get up to dodge the car or drag the body of his brother if he got hit somehow? The car passes the kid with the car, hitting the kid with glasses on the ground. The kid with the car then drags the dead body of his brother (the one with glasses) off the road. In the next scene, he is pretending to be his brother since everyone likes that brother more. It's confirmed because he has the car he likes so much in his bag, still carrying it with him because he loves it, but hiding it in his backpack, zipping it closed to show that he's going to step into the role of his brother so no one will really know what happened. It's foreshadowing. Kid has car toy that he loves, brother with glasses is liked more by everyone, he dies, kid with toy car becomes kid with glasses to be liked by everyone.

comments.text:
Hey Cory! I don't do this often, but I just wanted to congratulate you, my favourite youtuber, on 23 MILLION subscribers!  I still remember the 7M subscriber video I've watched, how you were watching some samurai's congratulation videos and how thankful you were. 7 million was a great achievement, but 23? That's 23 million people, no, SAMURAI watching your videos and enjoying your content. 

I think I can speak for all of us when I say you bring a smile to our faces. I haven't been watching you for that long, but in the nearly two to three year time span I've been watching you, you're one of the few youtubers that actually make me feel like I'm here in the moment. It doesn't feel like a pre-recorded video, nor like I'm watching you on a screen or something. It feels like I'm watching WITH you and that's really a rare thing most youtubers can't achieve.

Unrelated, but I'm investing in a shelf to store my first ever manga series; Monsters We Make (and hopefully some MWM merch too! That'd be dope). So you better keep making more of those! My MWM 2 arrived not too long ago even though I ordered it the same day you uploaded thee announcement. But since I'm in Europe it took a while and a lot of money. (Yes you have fans all the way in Europe!) But honestly, if spending that much means I can support you in any way, I don't care about the price.

You're a great guy, Cory. Keep up the work, the samurai will stand with you and support you until the very end. And once again, SAMURAI STAND UP! 🧍🏾‍♀🙋🏾‍♀❤
